frequency_question: What proportion of highly contested executive branch nominees facing strong opposition secure floor confirmation within a restricted final legislative window?
membership_rule: Includes cabinet secretaries and major agency heads (FDA, EPA, SEC, etc.) whose nominations faced organized Senate opposition, committee delays, or floor controversy. Excludes routine, non-controversial voice-vote confirmations.

cases.name: Robert Califf FDA Commissioner Confirmation (Second Nomination)

coverage_note: 4 named episodes representing high-stakes executive branch confirmations with intense partisan friction; believed roughly 12 such severe friction cases in total over the window.
known_gaps: Excludes routine withdrawals that happen quietly before committee hearings.
skeleton: Contested executive nominations subject to intense floor friction evaluated across recent congressional terms.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 4 listed comparable contested episodes
validity_reason: Base rate tied to current Senate polarization and filibuster/cloture dynamics which remain stable through the current congressional term.
